reason: The hypothesis combines two well-documented but previously separate mechanisms—stress-induced phase transformation/amorphization (from P1, P6, P37) and grain boundary nanosegregation embrittlement (from P12, P23, P26)—into a single, integrated proposal for toughness loss in a nominally single-phase FCC HEA under demanding loading. It further proposes that these mechanisms are triggered by a common precursor (localized stacking fault networks) and that their relative contributions depend on service conditions, which is a synthesis not stated in any single passage. The falsification test, while using standard methods, is designed to disentangle these two mechanisms, addressing a gap between the TRIP/amorphization literature and the GB segregation literature.
